name: Sympl Lead Intake and Proposal Generation Workflow

nodes.name: Lead Webhook Ingress
nodes.notes: Receives lead submission payload from website form, Typeform, or CRM deal trigger.

options.systemMessage: You are an intake parsing agent for Sympl Solutions accounting practice. Extract structured organization information and candidate services. You are strictly forbidden from deciding final scope or pricing.

nodes.name: AI Unstructured Extractor
nodes.notes: LangChain Agent using OpenAI / Claude to extract entities and candidate needs. Strictly forbidden from deciding approved scope.

nodes.name: Structured Schema Validator
nodes.notes: Normalizes AI outputs into standard draft schema.

nodes.name: Missing Information Branch
nodes.notes: Checks whether mandatory organization, contact, and requirements exist.

nodes.name: HubSpot Deal Create
nodes.notes: Creates HubSpot Deal and logs draft scope for audit.

nodes.name: Human Scope Approval Gate
nodes.notes: MANDATORY SCOPE FIREWALL: Pauses workflow until Account Executive explicitly checks approved service families and pricing.

nodes.name: Scope Firewall Audit Guard
nodes.notes: Validates that approved_scope is non-empty and strictly isolated from requested_scope.

nodes.name: Sympl API Dispatcher
nodes.notes: Dispatches approved proposal generation request to Sympl Backend API.

nodes.name: Trigger Workflow 2
nodes.notes: Handoff to Workflow 2 with job_id and CRM deal_id.
